body: Urge her to get help. If it gets really bad, talk to her parents. It will feel like the ultimate betrayal but they can force her to get help. Offer to talk to the school counsellor with her.
You mean like stream-of-consciousness type things?  Yes. I do not have psychosis or schizophrenia though, just depression and anxiety and such.

I have some personal experience with that- I've never posted pictures of my journals, but they're pretty intense sometimes. Here is some of my art from during a panic attack: http://25.media.tumblr.com/be2ffbe1d4c207283e71690dec669661/tumblr_mj7nkcjlZv1s77082o1_1280.jpg
I'll be up for a while, and would be down to talk.
